claims.statement: The workflow supports an evidence-governed pilot decision.
A clean trial builds a memo and lineage graph without paid services.
Every memo claim maps through explicit edges to eligible evidence.
Unknown or ineligible evidence citations fail closed.
Two lineage and graph projects were screened without adding unnecessary infrastructure.
A synthetic lineage requirement links change and regression evidence.
Source-truth, threshold and human-authority limitations remain explicit.
A human adjudication receipt can retain a conflict block without rewriting evidence, promoting a source or bypassing citation gates.
A validated conflict receipt can produce an actionable, non-executing triage work item while keeping evidence blocked pending human decision.
A bounded triage outcome report exposes owner-action status and completion criteria without promoting evidence or executing outreach.
A chronological triage-history summary exposes lifecycle status without promoting evidence, rewriting the memo or executing outreach.

boundaries: The graph validates declared links; it does not independently verify evidence truth, causality or recommendation quality.
All records and feedback are synthetic; no real consulting adoption or business outcome is claimed.
A real pilot requires accountable evidence owners, authenticated storage, source verification, approved thresholds and a human go/no-go decision.
